FailureReasonCode.description:
Stable failure categories a caller may branch on.

A value is never renamed, repurposed or removed within the public contract. New values may be
added, so a caller must treat an unrecognized value as a generic failure and use ``status`` for the
category.
FailureReasonCode.title: FailureReasonCode

RefreshResultDocument.description:
One (ticker, selection) job of a refresh.

Exactly one of a saved run (``analysis_run_id``), an unsaved outcome (``status`` with no run) and a failure
(``error``) describes the job, and ``reason_code`` is set if and only if ``error`` is.

analysis_run_id.description: The saved run; null when nothing was saved.
analysis_run_id.title: Analysis Run Id

error.description: The failure's message for people; null unless the job failed.
error.title: Error

reason_code.description: The stable code of the failure; null unless it failed.

status.description: The run's or the unsaved outcome's status; null for a failed job.

RefreshResultDocument.title: RefreshResultDocument

RunOutcome.description:
Terminal outcome of a workspace analysis run.

Only terminal states exist; there is deliberately no in-progress value because
the envelope records an immutable completed attempt rather than live state.
RunOutcome.title: RunOutcome

description:
The one document ``refresh --json`` writes when the refresh completes.

This document is unversioned: it has no ``schema_version``.

counts.description: Jobs per status; a failed job counts as 'error'.
counts.title: Counts
